index 7505656..e1128fa 100644
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -1 +1,30 @@
 # fixture repo
+
+## Running the tests
+
+This project does not have a test suite yet — there is no `tests/` directory and no test dependencies are declared. The commands below describe the intended workflow; until tests are added, `pytest` will simply report that it collected zero items.
+
+The modules are plain Python with no third-party dependencies, so a virtual environment plus [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/) is all that is needed:
+
+```bash
+python -m venv .venv
+source .venv/bin/activate
+pip install pytest
+```
+
+Run the full suite from the repository root:
+
+```bash
+pytest
+```
+
+Run a single test file, or a single test within it:
+
+```bash
+pytest tests/test_pricing_cache.py
+pytest tests/test_pricing_cache.py::test_lookup_falls_back_to_snapshot
+```
+
+Useful flags while developing: `-v` for one line per test, `-x` to stop at the first failure, and `-k <expression>` to select tests by name substring.
+
+New tests belong in a `tests/` directory at the repository root, in files named `test_*.py`, with test functions named `test_*` — that is the default layout pytest discovers without any configuration.
